newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank drains PLN 565 mln from money market.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank drains PLN 565 mln from money market.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 565 million zlotys from the market for five and 10 days through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 665 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The bank drained the market for five days at a maximum rate of 22.09 percent and for 10 days at a maximum rate of 22.13.
The average rate was 22.06 percent for the 5-day drainage and 22.11 percent for the 10-day reverse repo.
The central bank also sold 92 million zlotys of its 91-day NBP-bills after Polish banks bid for 93 million. @
The average rate of the 91-day paper, available only to Polish banks, inched up to 22.19 percent from 22.17 percent on April 15.
